name: claude-session-relay
description: Drive the Claude Code tabs of any VS Code window from a script or a web panel: open, resume, start a conversation that runs its prompt on its own, rename and close sessions through a plain file inbox.

claudeSessionRelay.enabled.description: Listen for requests in this window.

claudeSessionRelay.inbox.description: Folder that holds one inbox per workspace. Empty: %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-session-relay on Windows, ~/.claude-session-relay elsewhere. ~ and %VAR% are expanded.

claudeSessionRelay.workspaces.description: How a window names itself, tried in order: { "pattern": regex over the folder path, "name": text that may use $1 }. Without a match the name is the folder's base name.

claudeSessionRelay.onlyMatchingWorkspace.description: Only listen in windows whose folder matches one of the workspace rules.

claudeSessionRelay.claudeConfigDir.description: Only listen when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR matches this regex (to keep one Claude account apart from another). Empty: any.

claudeSessionRelay.aiThreadsHome.description: Home folder of ai-threads. When set, and its hooks are installed for the conversation's Claude account, auto-start hands the prompt to ai-threads, which then arms the watch and delivers. Empty: the relay delivers by itself. ~ and %VAR% are expanded.

scripts.test: node test/relay.test.js && node test/cli.test.js && node test/hook.test.js
